product.olivetti-pcs33.summary: Compact 1992 desktop with a 25 MHz 386SX, for general office use.
product.olivetti-pcs33.history: The PCS 33 came out in November 1992 with the PCS 11 and PCS 44, as the middle model for general office use: 25 MHz 386SX, 2 MB of memory, a 1.44 MB floppy drive and a 40 to 120 MB hard disk, with MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0 preinstalled. It uses the BA013/25 board, the same technical base as the M300-02F, with its own BIOS (R6.03).
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.verifie: The R6.03 BIOS (128 KB) is identified and runs on the same BA013/25 emulation as the M300-02F.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.limitat: Partial, provisional emulation. No PCS 33 manual confirms the board, and the case is not modelled. Booting with its own BIOS still has to be checked.
No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-pcs33.creation.model: 1992 PCS 33: 25 MHz 386SX, 2 MB, integrated WD90C11 and one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-pcs33.creation.note: This board’s BIOS supports only four drive types. If you add the disk, choose the type shown in the option in Setup. The disk connects to the board’s IDE interface.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.cpu: 25 MHz Intel 386SX on the BA013/25 board, with an i387SX socket. VLSI TOPCAT chipset: VL82C320 system controller and VL82C331 bus controller. Two 16-bit ISA slots on the bus expansion board. Data taken from the BA013 board shared with the M300-02/02F; there is no PCS service guide.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.memory: Bank 0 with 2 MB soldered and bank 1 with two sockets for 1 M × 9 SIMMs (2 MB in total) or 4 M × 9 SIMMs (8 MB in total): 2, 4 or 10 MB. 80 ns access.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.video: Integrated VGA: Western Digital WD90C11A, WD90C64 clock generator and Brooktree BT476 DAC. BluMach uses its WD90C11 model with 512 KB.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.storage: 3.5-inch 1.44 MB or 5.25-inch 1.2 MB floppy drive, with an Acer controller and serial and parallel ports in the 87C310. The IDE disk uses a buffered interface on the board. The BIOS table has only four types; the first three are 965/5/17 (40 MB), 975/10/17 (85 MB) and 761/8/39 (120 MB).
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.firmwar: BIOS R6.03 (03/01/93), 128 KB, is preserved. Its disk table is the same as in the PCS 11 BIOS images.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.commerc: Introduced in November 1992 with 2 MB, a 1.44 MB floppy drive, a 40 to 120 MB hard disk, MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.press: Computer Business Review, 15/11/1992: launch of the PCS 11, PCS 33 and PCS 44.
